facts.title: Web Awesome
facts.description: Build better with Web Awesome, the biggest open source library of meticulously designed, highly customizable, and framework-agnostic UI components.

research.name: Web Awesome
research.note: Framework-agnostic web components with themes and CSS utilities from the Font Awesome team, successor to Shoelace.
unverified: The core component source is public in github.com/shoelace-style/webawesome (MIT); research that repository instead of this site.
